title: Decision-maker may approve a strata lot of lesser average site area for apartments R40 to R60
text: Notwithstanding M4.1.2, for apartments in areas coded R40 - R60; the decision-maker may approve a development application involving the creation of a strata lot of a lesser average site area than that specified in Table 4B provided that the proposed variation does not limit the ability for the development to achieve the relevant provisions of the R-Codes, and will: i. facilitate housing and dwelling diversity; ii. facilitate the protection of an environmental or heritage feature; iii. facilitate the retention of a significant element that contributes toward an existing streetscape worthy of retention; iv. allow land to be developed with housing of the same types and form as land in the vicinity and which would not otherwise be able to be developed; or v. achieve specific objectives of the local planning framework.

replaces.note: current P1.1.2 allows only 5% via the WAPC

notes: New here (no Chapter 3 equivalent; ch3 M4.1.3 is the corner-lot variation over 5% for R10-R35). Limited to R40-R60 and to a development application creating a strata lot; the ToC omits both. The Explanatory Guidelines say site area variations may be approved 'where the WAPC is satisfied', conflicting with 'decision-maker' (verify). The 'dwelling diversity' ground is open-ended. No limit on the size of the variation.

verified.note: Page says 'the decision-maker' and 'R40 - R60'; the Explanatory Guidelines conflict is outside this page.
